name: Celestial Mosaic Atrium
description: An expansive atrium whose floor and walls are a living mosaic of constellations that shift with the viewer’s movement.
prompt: Grand atrium with high vaulted ceiling, floor and walls covered in interactive mosaic tiles depicting constellations that gently animate and rearrange as a person walks, soft ambient light, futuristic yet organic design, 8k.
caption: Step into a sky that rewrites itself beneath your feet. 🌌🖼️ #CelestialMosaicAtrium
